test_title: PYST 11 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Which of the following sentences uses the word "bat" with the same meaning as in the following sentence?

"He took a swing with his new wooden bat"

options.text: The bat is the only flying mammal.
The coach handed him the bat before he went up to the plate.
A furry little bat got into the attic last night.
The bat's wingspan was surprisingly large.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bat"** in the given sentence refers to a sports equipment used in games like baseball or cricket. It is a long, flat, or round wooden or metal stick. (बैट/डंडा)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** A piece of equipment used by a player to hit the ball in sports like baseball or cricket.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** बल्ला या डंडा (खेलों में उपयोग होने वाला उपकरण)
 
• **Example:** He bought a new cricket bat for the tournament.
 

 
• **Correct Word Explanation:** In the correct option (Option 2), the word "bat" is used in the same context as the question sentence, referring to the piece of sports equipment. (बैट/खेल उपकरण)

 
 
• **Example:** The coach handed him the bat before he went up to the plate, indicating it is used in a game.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "The bat is the only flying mammal." 
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** चमगादड़ (एकमात्र उड़ने वाला स्तनधारी)
 
• **Explanation:** In this option, "bat" refers to the flying mammal, not the sports equipment.
 
• **Example:** The bat flew out of the cave at night.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "A furry little bat got into the attic last night."
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** चमगादड़ (एक जानवर)
 
• **Explanation:** This option also refers to the animal bat, not the sports equipment.
 
• **Example:** We found a bat hanging from the ceiling.
 
 

 
• **Option 4:** "The bat's wingspan was surprisingly large."
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** चमगादड़ के पंख (जानवर के संदर्भ में)
 
• **Explanation:** This option describes the wingspan of the flying mammal bat.
 
• **Example:** The bat's wingspan stretched over two feet.
 
 

3a:Tcf0,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
